title: Digital accessibility of public services (France, RGAA)
description: Preselected for the public sector: keep it when the product delivers websites, packaged software used through a browser or mobile applications to a French public body, to a private body with a public service mission, or to a company with a French turnover of 250 million euros or more (Art. 47 of loi n° 2005-102); decline it outside France or for a customer outside that scope. It adds the RGAA audit, statement, mentions and plans to public-sector-accessibility (EU).

sources.title: DINUM, RGAA, Référentiel général d'amélioration de l'accessibilité
